chunks: I place my trust in God who is my Lord and your Lord. There is no creature that moves on the earth who is not held by the forelock firmly by Him. Verily the way of my Lord is straight.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God holds every creature by its forelock?
ai.summary: In the context of Prophet Hud’s address to his people, this verse underscores Tawakkul as both a spiritual stance and a practical reality, affirming that God’s grip on every creature’s 'forelock' signifies His continuous, active control over creation. Shia scholarship often views this 'forelock' (nāṣiyya) as a metaphor for divine decree and guidance, reminding believers that while human effort is required, ultimate success rests in the Straight Path (Ṣirāṭ al-Mustaqīm) of Allah.
